test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A piece of cake
solution:
The correct answer is **'To be easy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate answer for the given idiom ' **A piece of cake**' is '**to be easy**'.
 
• A piece of cake means something easily done.
 
 
• For eg:- This job interview will be** a piece of cake** for you.
